Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You whisper into the wind and wait for the familiar answer to find its way home.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes to contact; up to one minute of exchange.
Target / range / shape
One willing creature personally known to you within one day’s ordinary travel; ten minutes.
Duration
The exchange lasts at most one minute after contact.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per recipient per day. No mind reading or ability to command the listener.
Type
Magic / Utility

Name the recipient and speak a message of up to twenty words. If the recipient is outside range or unwilling, learn only that no contact was made. The message conveys your identity but reveals no location. No sight or attack path is required; this is communication, not targeting for another card.

Weak
Deliver the message; the recipient may acknowledge receipt with a yes or no.
Standard
Deliver it and receive a willing reply of up to twenty words.
Strong
Deliver it and exchange up to three messages of twenty words each in both directions during the next minute.

Source: design/cards/a-voice-across-the-valley.md at bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809.
